# Zcalculate — Floating Web Calculator

> Free floating web calculator and always-on-top online calculator suite with 40+ professional tools for math, finance, health, and science. Features document picture-in-picture support for seamless multitasking across browser tabs.

## Site Info
- URL: https://zcalculate.online
- Category: Online Calculator / Web Application / Utility
- Language: English (en-US)
- Free to use: Yes (no ads, no accounts, no fees)

## Main Features
- Floating web calculator with Picture-in-Picture API support
- Always on top calculator that stays visible across browser tabs
- Resizable calculator interface with dark mode
- 40+ specialized calculators across four categories
- Real-time instant results computed entirely in-browser
- Calculation history saved locally via IndexedDB
- PWA-capable (installable as a desktop/mobile app)

## Financial Calculators
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/mortgage-calculator): Monthly payment, amortization schedule, total interest
- [Loan Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/loan-calculator): Personal/business loan payment estimator
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/auto-loan-calculator): Car payment with trade-in, tax, down payment
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/compound-interest-calculator): Daily, monthly, quarterly, annual compounding
- [Interest Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/interest-calculator): Simple vs compound interest comparison
- [Investment Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/investment-calculator): Portfolio growth with recurring contributions
- [Retirement Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/retirement-calculator): Savings projection with 4% withdrawal rule
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/income-tax-calculator): Federal tax brackets and effective rate
- [Salary Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/salary-calculator): Annual to hourly/weekly/monthly conversion
- [Amortization Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/amortization-calculator): Detailed periodic payment breakdown
- [Inflation Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/inflation-calculator): Purchasing power over time
- [Payment Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/payment-calculator): Monthly installment for any financed purchase
- [Finance Calculator (TVM)](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/finance-calculator): Time Value of Money solver
- [Interest Rate Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/interest-rate-calculator): Reverse-solve for APR from payments
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://zcalculate.online/calculator/sales-tax-calculator): Tax amount and total price
